notes.title: 0.135 update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, here are some recent updates I've made:
- Modified income mechanics: Income is now more stable, but skilled players can earn more money.
- Revised Combo system: Combo is now capped within a reasonable range to prevent excessive values.
- Added new items that boost income and Combo earnings.
- Fixed a bug where Settings couldn't be opened after returning to the main menu.
- Fixed text display errors.
- New hit effects when taking damage.
- New low-health visual effects for players.
- Enhanced overheating effects—now with realistic fire visuals!
- Adjusted Waterproof Structure: Now reduces water damage by half instead of granting full immunity.
- Tuned stage difficulty—it might be harder now?
- Buffed boss encounters.
- Fixed a bug where new skills could appear after already selecting 4 skills.
- Merchant item change: Now provides "+1 Shop Item Slot".
- Additional click sound effects.
- Optimized post-wave UI.
- Passive shields now require unlocking shield skills first.
- Increased prices for certain items.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes: Add welcome ui and link icon.

notes.title: 0.134. Update
notes.notes:
After each wave countdown, you will no longer be directly taken to the shop. You can continue to kill enemies until the last one is defeated, or press F to end the wave immediately.
 The aircraft selection interface now allows you to go back.
 Fixed a bug where unlocked aircraft in version 0.133 were not being saved.
 Fixed camera boundary issues.
 The skill selection interface now displays the corresponding keys for each skill.
 The gamepad will now vibrate when the player is hit.
 Fixed a bug where clearing save data did not reset achievements.

notes.title: 0.133 update
notes.notes:

notes.title: Playtest update
notes.notes: The difficulty of the tutorial level boss has been reduced.
